questions.q: What event led Neil Strauss to start rehab for sex addiction?
a: Cheating on his girlfriend with her best friend
questions.why: He cheated on his girlfriend, prompting rehab.

questions.q: Polyamory originally arose as a protest against what societal norm?
questions.why: It protested monogamy and strict marriage.

questions.q: According to Strauss, what childhood factor often creates love addicts?
questions.why: Emotionally distant parents lead to love addiction.

questions.q: What two steps does Strauss suggest for building a healthy self-relationship?
questions.why: He proposes empty out then fill up.

questions.q: Why does therapy aim to help both love addicts and avoiders?
a: To build a healthy relationship with themselves
